CustomField.description: One-shot guard for the Checklist__c fan-out. A SEPARATE FIELD FROM Tasks_Fanned_Out__c ON PURPOSE, and this is the single most important field of the migration: the Task model and the Checklist model must coexist during cutover, and sharing one guard would make either fan-out suppress the other. It is also a single-writer discriminator - only ChecklistFanoutService writes it - so TestDataFactory and every seed script are immune by construction rather than by a bypass flag. The group F reconcile keys on this field, never on Tasks_Fanned_Out__c, so it cannot disturb the legacy model.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked once the new checklist has been generated for this deal. System-maintained; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Checklist Fanned Out
